claims.statement: The United States offered energy companies loans of up to 40 million barrels from the Strategic Petroleum Reserve.
Emergency public stock is being converted into temporary refinery supply through a repayable loan mechanism.
Cheniere Marketing and Petrobras entered a 22-year LNG sale and purchase agreement for about 0.8 mtpa on an FOB basis.
The EIB and BNP Paribas signed a 700 million euro guarantee agreement for European electricity-grid manufacturers, expected to stimulate up to 2.8 billion euro of investment.
Financial risk capacity is being converted into prospective manufacturing and grid capacity.
China will collect an additional 55 percent tariff on Brazilian beef from October 1 after Brazil reached its annual 1.1 million-tonne quota.
The Brazil-China beef route is crossing from quota access into a sharply more expensive market-access regime.
Middle East crude exports had recovered and Saudi East-West Pipeline flows had resumed while oil prices responded to Iran-sanctions headlines.
The price move does not constitute an independent system-state transition while the previously recorded logistics recovery continues.
